mapper.select: select lot_id, ncr_no from qms_ncr where status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING') and lot_id in #{id} order by lot_id, ncr_id
select item_class_id from mst_item where item_id = #{itemId}
select distinct gauge_class from qms_insp_plan_line where insp_plan_id = #{planId} and gauge_class is not null and gauge_class <> 'VISUAL' order by gauge_class

select a.gauge_class, a.use_yn, lc.result as last_result, lc.next_due_date from mst_phys_asset a left join lateral ( select c.result, c.next_due_date from qms_gauge_calib c where c.asset_id = a.asset_id and c.void_yn = 'N' order by c.calib_date desc, c.calib_id desc limit 1) lc on true where a.asset_type = 'GAUGE' and a.use_yn = 'Y' and a.gauge_class in #{c}
